components.explanation: art/sheets/lantern_flame.png: a 48 x 32 sprite sheet (12 x 16 cells, 4 x 2, flame base at (6, 15) in every cell) written by make_lantern_flame_sheet.gd (Claude Code, Zhaohui's choice); MIT, credits in ATTRIBUTION.md; imported with nearest filtering.

animations/lantern_flicker.tres keys Sprite2D:frame 0-7 every 0.1 s, UPDATE_DISCRETE, length 0.8, LOOP_LINEAR; lantern_flame.tscn slices the sheet 4 x 2 with offset (-6, -15); lantern_flame.gd only play()s and seek()s once (start_offset 0.0 / 0.4); two instances in game/main.tscn after Embers. The AnimationPlayer is the one writer of the frame, on the idle tick.

animations/kick_arc.tres keys Pivot:visible, rotation and modulate at Fighter.frame 0, 7, 8, 12, 13, 27, 28 over 60 (step 1/60, length 28/60, LOOP_NONE; transitions 0.5 / 2.0 / 1 / 1 / 0.4); kick_rest.tres hides the arc; fighter.tscn holds KickRig -> Pivot -> Trail, Core (Polygon2D) and a MANUAL AnimationPlayer. The preview scene makes the fixture strips.

fighter/kick_rig.gd: each physics tick at priority 100 (after Main), state kick -> seek(Fighter.frame / 60, true) on kick_arc; any other state -> rest. Reads the state machine, never writes it; writes only KickRig's own position and scale.

fighter/fighter.gd (unchanged by A7): ATTACKS kick 7 / 5 / 16, frame counted from 0 on the kick's first tick, check_hit while 7 < frame <= 12, whiff at 13, idle at 28; receive_hit interrupts a kick (hurt); _update_sprite is the one writer of the fighter's Sprite2D.

tests/test_lantern_readback.gd (47 / 0), test_kick_readback.gd (52 / 0), test_anim_states.gd (58 / 0, measured clock gap 0 s), test_kick_edges.gd (38 / 0), test_pins_a7.gd (19 / 0 before and after) and the shared anim_checks.gd (track_problems); three mutations fail them.
